description.language: Language for asset names and metadata.
description.codice_fondo: Internal Borsa Italiana fund code (e.g. 2FADB602822). Auto-filled for mutual funds; enables NAV pricing. Leave empty for stocks/bonds/ETFs.
description.mic: Market MIC (e.g. ETLX for EuroTLX, MOTX for MOT). Auto-filled from the search result; routes the instrument page and metadata to the right market.
description.platform: Trading platform (e.g. TLX for EuroTLX). Auto-filled from the search result; required by some markets to resolve the instrument page.
